The '''Vesper Dux Ultra-3''' was constructed by the [[Ghishi (species)|Ghishi]] [[Kraid Nemmeso]]. Nemmeso was unable to compete on the battlefields of his [[Ghishi|homeworld]], and intended to use the massive Vesper Dux Ultra-3 to instead compete in [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] and prove his worth to other members of his species.<ref name="Star Wars: Racer Revenge: Prima's Official Strategy Guide">[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Racer Revenge'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>
